title: Brazil's Lula arrives in PH for state visit, ASEAN summit
summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva arrived in the Philippines on Friday, Nov. 13, for his state visit in Manila upon the invitation of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
